uart_quality_last_hour.title: Chất lượng UART 1 giờ qua (dòng tốt / hỏng)
uart_quality_last_hour.sql: SELECT checksum, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM events WHERE recv_ts_utc >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-1 hour') GROUP BY checksum

latest_per_node.title: Bản tin mới nhất của từng node
latest_per_node.sql: SELECT source, record_type, MAX(recv_ts_utc) AS last_seen, COUNT(*) AS n FROM events WHERE record_type IN ('SENSOR_DATA','LOCAL') GROUP BY source, record_type ORDER BY source

perf_summary_latest_run.title: PERF_SUMMARY của run mới nhất
perf_summary_latest_run.sql: SELECT recv_ts_utc, source, json_extract(payload_json,'$.received') AS received, json_extract(payload_json,'$.expected') AS expected, json_extract(payload_json,'$.final') AS final, json_extract(payload_json,'$.flood_delivery_x100')/100.0 AS flood_delivery_pct, json_extract(payload_json,'$.delay_avg_us')/1000.0 AS delay_avg_ms FROM events WHERE record_type='PERF_SUMMARY' AND run=(SELECT MAX(run) FROM events WHERE record_type='PERF_SUMMARY') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200

mqtt_backlog.title: Số bản ghi chưa gửi lên EMQX
mqtt_backlog.sql: SELECT published, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY published
